key.name: top-right-swipe-activation
key.summary: When to enable the top-right swipe gesture
key.description: Controls whether the top-right swipe → Quick Settings gesture is active. "off" disables it entirely. "auto" enables it only when the system reports tablet mode (e.g. a convertible folded into tablet posture). "always" enables it regardless of mode.

key.name: top-right-zone-width-percent
key.description: Percentage of screen width, measured from the right edge, that counts as the trigger zone for the top-right swipe gesture.

key.name: panel-auto-hide-activation
key.summary: When to auto-hide the top panel
key.description: Controls whether the top panel auto-hides when a window is maximized. "off" keeps the panel always visible. "auto" auto-hides only when the system is in tablet mode. "always" auto-hides in both laptop and tablet modes. The panel reveals on top-edge hover and during panel menu interactions.

key.name: bottom-edge-swipe-activation
key.summary: When to enable the bottom-edge swipe gesture
key.description: Controls whether swiping up from the bottom edge of the screen opens the Activities overview. "off" disables it entirely. "auto" enables it only when the system reports tablet mode. "always" enables it regardless of mode.

key.name: top-center-swipe-activation
key.summary: When to enable the top-center swipe gesture
key.description: Controls whether swiping down from the top-center edge of the screen opens the date menu (notifications and calendar). "off" disables it entirely. "auto" enables it only when the system reports tablet mode. "always" enables it regardless of mode.

key.name: top-center-zone-width-percent
key.summary: Width of the top-center trigger zone
key.description: Percentage of the monitor width, centered horizontally, that counts as the top-center trigger zone for the notifications swipe gesture.

key.name: flick-to-close-activation
key.summary: When to enable flick-to-close in the Activities overview
key.description: Controls whether flicking upward on a window preview in the Activities overview closes that window. "off" disables it entirely. "auto" enables it only when the system reports tablet mode. "always" enables it regardless of mode.

key.name: overview-workspace-switch-activation
key.summary: When to enable single-finger workspace switching in the overview
key.description: Controls whether a single-finger horizontal swipe over the overview background switches workspaces, tracking the finger 1:1 like the native four-finger touchpad swipe. "off" disables it entirely. "auto" enables it only when the system reports tablet mode. "always" enables it regardless of mode.

key.name: overview-vertical-swipe-activation
key.summary: When to enable vertical swipe between overview states
key.description: Controls whether a single-finger vertical swipe over the overview background moves between overview states: swipe up reveals the app grid, swipe down returns to the windows view or to the desktop. "off" disables it entirely. "auto" enables it only when the system reports tablet mode. "always" enables it regardless of mode.
